{{Top|leg}}
A '''magnetic attractor''' was a hand tool used by mechanics to recover metal objects.

The magnetic attractor was little more than a short rod that contained a powerful [[Electromagnet/Legends|electromagnet]]. When activated, one end of the tool became highly magnetized, creating an extremely focused and uni-directional magnetic field, which was used to attract large or heavy objects. The tool had multiple power settings, depending on the required amount of force needed to recover a specific object.

Many of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] best [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]] used magnetic retrievers to recover [[Steelton/Legends|Steelton]] [[control cable]]s that had come loose, using the tool's incredible attractive powers to retrieve the cables from a distance, all at speeds that neared 1,000 kilometers per hour.
